title: Step
description: Request and response (StepResult) for the `step` tool (spec section 5.2): execute an action, advance simulation time, return observation + reward. Step responses SHOULD be compact (alerts, feedback, deltas); full state belongs to `observe`.

AgentId.description: Registered agent ID; MAY be omitted in single-agent sessions (the step is attributed to the sole registered agent)

Ticks.description: Simulation ticks to advance. 0 = apply action without advancing time.

parameterized_action.description: Parameterized action: PascalCase Type plus flattened parameters beside it (no nested params object — a change from draft-00). Example: {"Type": "PlaceBuildingNear", "Building": "Bed", "Near": "Stockpile", "Count": 3}

response.description: StepResult returned by `step` (and by `reset` as the initial observation) Default elision (spec §5.2): servers MAY omit Reward (0), Done (false), Truncated (false), and empty RewardComponents/Events/FrameIds; absence means the default value.

Tick.description: Current simulation tick after the step

Observation.description: Agent-scoped observation; sections per the Observation Contract (spec section 6)

Reward.description: Scalar reward for the causal action; MUST be delivered synchronously in this response (REQ-RWD-01)

RewardComponents.description: Decomposition of Reward, keyed by component name declared in the manifest

Done.description: Episode reached a terminal state; further `step` calls error -32002 until `reset`

Truncated.description: Episode cut by a time limit rather than a terminal state

TerminationReason.description: Why the episode ended (when Done or Truncated is true); null while the episode is running

Events.description: Notable events that occurred during this step

Error.description: Non-null when the action failed (REQ-ERR-01: loud errors); MUST identify the failing action and an actionable reason (REQ-ERR-02)

Feedback.description: Human/LLM-readable account of what the action did; the primary in-context learning signal for LLM agents

FrameIds.description: Vision stream frame references, keyed by StreamId (spec section 11)

StateHash.description: Hash of the post-step state for determinism verification
